items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens to fill void from Lamar IR and Huntley season-ending turf toe; deal expected this weekend. Fagnano starts Thursday.
items.why: Schefter/Rapoport dual report; Ravens QB room depleted.
items.implication: Brissett likely starts post-Thursday; more dropbacks/less scramble than Lamar per Levitan.
items.opportunity: BAL pass-catchers (Flowers etc.) get volume boost vs mobile QB baseline.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery and will be placed on IR after injuring it on the first snap vs Bills; out indefinitely, potentially season-ending. Joe Fagnano starts Thursday vs JAX; Brissett trade incoming.
items.why: Right thumb injury on first play Week 8; surgery confirmed by coach and Schefter.
items.implication: Ravens offense without Lamar indefinitely; earliest return Week 14 post-bye. Drop in redraft.
items.opportunity: Increased pass volume potential with backup QBs; Flowers/Andrews targets rise short-term.

items.text: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley season-ending turf toe injury requiring surgery (similar to Burrow prior); confirms Lamar out indefinitely, Fagnano starts TNF.
items.implication: Full QB crisis for BAL until Brissett arrives; impacts all pass catchers ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Flowers etc. still startable but QB quality downgrade.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love placed on IR with high-ankle sprain, out 4-to-5 weeks.
items.why: Another high-ankle sprain; Rapoport and RotoWire confirm IR designation.
items.implication: Out multiple weeks; Cardinals RB depth thins further with Conner also IR.
items.opportunity: Handcuff or committee backs in ARI gain carries/snaps.

items.text: Levitan on Brissett to Ravens: worse than Lamar creates more pass volume and fewer scrambles — that's the whole point for fantasy.
items.why: Brissett pocket passer vs Lamar dual-threat; reply context.
items.implication: BAL WRs/TEs see higher target volume opportunity.
items.opportunity: Boost Flowers/Andrews rankings slightly on pure dropback volume.

items.text: 49ers RB Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) said he 'feels great' and could practice and play this week; DNP Wednesday but positive.
items.why: Self-report feels great; Bosa returned, Evans also DNP.
items.implication: CMC likely back elevating SF offense; monitor practice Thursday/Friday.
items.opportunity: Full role return if active; no major beneficiary shift if in.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) DNP all week, listed questionable and likely game-time decision Thursday vs Ravens per coach.
items.why: No practice Mon-Wed; Coen says GTD.
items.implication: If OUT, JAC RB committee shifts; monitor inactives.
items.opportunity: Backups or committee mates (e.g. Rodriguez limited) could see more carries if inactive.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) remains out Sunday vs Chargers; coach says progress but will not play.
items.why: Groin; DNP Wednesday, Ryans confirms out.
items.implication: HOU RB volume to others (e.g. mix).
items.opportunity: Handcuffs or committee RBs elevated carries.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown misses another game due to lingering knee issue (DNP Wednesday); ETR flags for Week 9 team-by-team.
items.why: Recurring knee flare-up after prior ankle; missed Week 8, DNP this week.
items.implication: NE WR corps thin; Maye targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Other NE WRs (Douglas etc.) see elevated routes/targets.

items.text: ETR Waiver: Mike Washington handed LV workhorse role Week 8 (25-2 carries edge over Ashton Jeanty); sticky TBD but workload noteworthy. Kubiak says week-to-week timeshare.
items.why: Jeanty 2 carries/9 yds + pass work; Washington 25/83. Coach: moving target.
items.implication: Jeanty still pass-catching lead but rush share collapsed; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Washington waiver priority as lead rusher; Jeanty flex if pass game holds.
items.conflict: Jeanty receiving volume elite but overall touches down.

items.text: Rams opening window for TE Terrance Ferguson return to practice. In last full game (Week 2, Nacua out): 42% slot/wide, 70% routes, 29% target share.
items.why: McVay opens window; Levitan prior route/target data when Nacua absent.
items.implication: Ferguson could carve TE/WR hybrid role if healthy; impacts Adams/Nacua shares mildly.
items.opportunity: Watch snaps/routes on return; prior 29% tgt share upside.

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace Week 9: DAL @ IND up in pace; HOU @ LAC slow slog. Other slate notes.
items.why: ETR Thorman analysis flags elevated pace for DAL-IND.
items.implication: More plays/snaps for skill players in that game; JT saga context from ETR.
items.opportunity: Volume boost for Lamb/Pickens/Taylor if roles hold.
items.conflict: JT saga continues per ETR team-by-team.

items.text: Levitan/Silva on SEA backfield with Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returns: 'like Charbonnet/Walker expect with worse versions of the players.'
items.why: Returns create timeshare; ETR video breakdown.
items.implication: Walker/Charbonnet/Price split dilutes individual upside ROS.
items.opportunity: Avoid heavy investment; handcuff all three for committee shares.

items.text: Berry Week 9 Sit/Start + Mailbag reacts to Jeremiyah Love IR placement among latest news; discusses tough keep-open/close-out decisions.
items.why: Podcast news segment flags Love IR.
items.implication: Adjust ARI RB rankings/starts; waiver implications for depth.
items.opportunity: Pivot to other ARI or waiver RBs.
